Name: Ahithophel the Gilonite
Summary: Ahithophel the Gilonite was David's counsellor, whose counsel was prized as if it were the oracle of God. He defected to Absalom, advised the rebellion, and when his counsel was rejected for Hushai's, he went home, set his house in order, and hanged himself.
KeyStory: Ahithophel's counsel was treated as God's own oracle — until one rejection drove him to hang himself.
RelatedPeople: King David; Absalom; Hushai the Archite; Eliam
LifeLesson: Brilliance without loyalty ends in despair; counsel is only as good as the master it serves.
